entities.summary: Sandrine Bony-Léna, née Bony, is a French-born climatologist who is currently Director of research at the Centre National de la Recherche Scientifique (CNRS) at Sorbonne University, Paris. Bony was notably a lead author of the Nobel Prize-winning (2007) Fourth Assessment Report of the Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change.
